commands_run: clan patch-data h1-clan/work/doc.clan --append risks '<one-entry array>' --agent risk-add --action ...

errors.what: First patch-data attempt used non-existent --merge flag
errors.recovered_by: Checked clan patch-data --help; used --append risks with a single-entry array (spec §24.3) instead

problems_and_friction: patch-data merge-patch replaces arrays wholesale, but --append (spec §24.3) let me concatenate just the one new risk entry, keeping authored bytes minimal instead of re-typing the full 4-entry array. The HTML row is literal (not bound), so a one-line <tr> append to #risk-rows covered the view.
context_understood: risks is a data-bound array plus a literal HTML risk table; adding a risk requires both an array append in data and a matching <tr> appended to the #risk-rows tbody, with pack-html forbidden.
